name: Happiness 1
tagline: Twenty-six premium 3 BHK villas in Vijayanagar.
description: Happiness 1 is a completed villa development in Vijayanagar 4th Stage, Mysuru. Twenty-six 3 BHK villas sit on a planned layout with landscaped green space between them.

items: RCC framed structure, Seismic Zone II compliant
Vitrified tiles in living, dining, kitchen and bedrooms
Anti-skid tiles in bathrooms and balconies
Main door in teak wood frame and shutter
Internal doors in solid wood frame with PU finish
Solid wood window frames and shutters

gallery.alt: A white villa at Happiness 1, its upper floor cantilevered over a covered car porch.
The street frontage of a Happiness 1 villa, with a mature tree at the boundary wall.
A row of Happiness 1 villas running along an internal road.
Stepped white terraces of the Happiness 1 villas seen along the street.
Planting and garden beds in the open space between the Happiness 1 villas.
Happiness 1 villas seen across a landscaped courtyard.

contentWarnings: Address incomplete. The live site's address block merges the project address into the M.K. Infra Holding corporate address at Srirangapatna (571438), so the project's own postcode is not recoverable. Only the verified lines are carried here.
Connectivity omitted. The live site shows one identical connectivity list on seven different projects in different neighbourhoods; the figures cannot all be true. Needs real per-project distances.
Live-site location copy for this project describes 'V4 homes' — another project's text. Not carried over.
The Happiness II brochure states Happiness reached occupancy of 26 units, which matches the 26 published here.
